issue.title: Staged monitor carries an uncommitted opened-repo edit, so a deploy command depending on that commit runs against the old tree

task_type_fields.impact: Any opened-repo edit plus a dependent staged monitor silently loses the edit's effect; it took an extra turn and explicit commit authorization to recover.
task_type_fields.location: SASE /sase_final opened-repo obligation vs staged-monitor carry (carry_allowed / submission_required)
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by bob-cli-k3.9--1, note #4 (epic bob-cli-k3). The cutover phase edited the linked `chezmoi` checkout, removing the 77-line `records:` mapping, and needed `chezmoi update -a --force` to run after that edit was committed. It staged that deployment command through `/sase_monitor`.

- Before staging, the final-declaration context required a commit decision for the opened repo `repo-504883e0d683`.
- After an unprepared monitor was staged, the same context reported `carry_allowed=true` and `submission_required=false`, and the session forbade optional declarations. The opened-repo edit was therefore never committed before the host started the monitor.
- The monitor (`psav64nvq48b`) ran `chezmoi update -a --force` against the uncommitted checkout and restored the committed `records:` mapping, undoing the deployment. A follow-up turn needed explicit `/sase_git_commit` authorization (chezmoi `fd393a3d`) before the deployment would stick.

Impact: any agent that edits an opened repo and then stages a monitor whose command depends on that edit being committed loses the edit's effect. SASE should either require the opened-repo commit decision whenever a staged monitor is carried, or commit pending opened-repo work before the host adopts the monitor.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-k3.9 staged chezmoi update after editing the linked chezmoi checkout; the final context dropped the opened-repo commit requirement once the monitor was staged, and the deploy restored the removed records mapping.

payload.description: Earlier opened-repo commit-obligation loss across a monitor handoff; adjacent root cause in the same final-declaration carry path
